notes: Configure this Ark at /config/https.html when the caretaker has a domain and internet access.
The running configuration, identity, account, email, certificates and private keys live under /etc/dataark, never in this public recipe.
Fresh source-based clones generate their own identity. No DEJ Software account or domain is required.
Manual DNS renewal requires caretaker intervention. Public certificate expiry does not disable HTTP or the offline library.
